EditTextPreference.title: Read-only API Key
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Enable Spot → Account → View account information and Withdrawal → View deposit/withdrawal details. Do not enable trading, withdrawal or transfer actions.

EditTextPreference.title: Read-only API Secret
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: The secret is shown once. Keep it private.

EditTextPreference.title: Settlement assets to import
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Comma-separated USD-pegged assets for deposit/withdrawal history. Current balance still includes all supported assets.

EditTextPreference.title: Load operations from
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Imports completed external stablecoin deposits and withdrawals. MEXC itself provides up to 90 days of this history.
